evals.prompt: Write a short update using the facts I already supplied.
evals.expected_output: Admit the exact supplied facts and open one writing turn, without requesting a research packet or external verification.

evals.prompt: Ghostwrite an operator brief from this evidence pack and objective.
evals.expected_output: Return publication-ready draft copy whose claims and caveats remain bound to supplied evidence.

evals.prompt: Admit these already supplied facts for a composing writer.
evals.expected_output: Return a ready source-bound writing context without writing, researching or claiming independent verification.
expectations: Do not invoke research or author the draft inside admission.

evals.prompt: Turn this completed research brief into an operator-facing draft.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the research brief and evidence log without repeating research or inventing claims.
expectations: Do not replace or expand claims beyond the supplied evidence.
